variants.label: 原神·赛璐璐修订
variants.prompt:
Paint ONE original female archer splash illustration in a distinctly flat, line-led Genshin Impact wish illustration direction. This is TWO-DIMENSIONAL ANIME DRAWING: clean fine colored outlines, broad local-color shapes, one or two decisive cel-shadow shapes per surface, sparing soft gradients only in focal face and hair. Golden armor is designed with simple gold planes and small graphic highlights, NOT mirror-shiny physically rendered metal. Crisp clear fresh illustration, NO realistic skin shading, NO 3D render, NO airbrushed photorealism, NO generic detailed castle background. Distinct controlled anime face and elegant organized hair shapes.
The input is a sprite sheet used only to identify the SAME adult female archer: long high scarlet-red ponytail, small gold head crest, indigo-violet fitted battle outfit and split cloth tails, gold shoulder armor/bracers/greaves, ivory recurved bow with gold fittings. Do not recreate pixel-art or repeated frames, do not copy any previous illustration composition.
Single full-body figure, portrait 2:3. Airborne sideways twist, face looking back toward her target, one leg tucked and one stretched, bow fully drawn diagonally with correct nocked arrow and anchored draw hand. Large graceful hair and violet cloth arcs. Spacious warm ivory-to-sky background with very few graphic wind shapes and leaves, no elaborate architecture. Genshin-style character wish artwork graphic finish, large readable silhouette and lively pose. No lettering, logo, card frame, UI, watermark, extra people, extra limbs or strings.

variants.label: FGO·线稿卡绘修订
variants.prompt:
Create ONE unmistakably LINE-DRAWN Japanese fantasy servant card illustration in the Fate/Grand Order classic polished anime card-art direction. Prioritize assertive clean ink contour, precise tapered interior strokes, an expressive angular anime face, flat jewel-colored areas and clearly designed hard cel shadows. Intricate detail should come from DRAWING rather than photographic surface texture. Gold armor rendered as graphic warm yellow and ochre shapes, violet cloth rendered with ink-defined fold rhythms. NOT 3D, NOT semi-realistic digital oil paint, NOT cinematic volumetric fog, NOT glossy airbrushing. The result should look like an accomplished printed Japanese character illustration.
Identity from input sprite sheet ONLY: same adult human archer, very long crimson high ponytail, gold small head crest, dark indigo-purple fitted outfit with split fabric panels, articulated gold lightweight armor and bracers/greaves, ivory-and-gold recurved longbow. Pixel sheet is just identity reference, not composition or medium.
Full-body vertical 2:3 portrait. A dramatic upward shooting pose: wide deep lunging legs form a stable triangular base, torso arches back, head tilted up and shown in readable profile-three-quarter, bow angled sharply up across the upper canvas, arrow correctly nocked at full draw, shoulders and arms coherent. Her long hair descends in a strong curving ribbon opposite the arrow direction. A refined dark violet and deep blue decorative night-sky field, small pale gold emblem-like shapes BEHIND her, sparse falling lights. Face, hands and bow clear. No text, game logo, card border, rarity stars, extra figures, realistic texture or photoreal metal.
